about: MAY this happen at this level — a DIFFERENT question from does-this-collide,
and the one a caller actually asks on every call.
It got its own file because the question asked on every call — may this happen at
this level — had no vector, so a surface nobody pinned could drift.
The trap is the last case. An opinion of `nothing above the bottom` collides
with nobody and permits nothing, so a caller checking only for collisions

coverage.criterion: every state, on a chain and on the two-element powerset, asked at the bottom, the top and a middle
coverage.why: two carriers for the named cases; the cross-check against walking the order is done by this file's runner on every statement and level of the chain

cases.name: nothing above the bottom does not collide and permits nothing

walked: the packed answer is the walked one: for every statement on the chain and every level, accepts holds exactly when the floor sits at or under the level and the level at or under the ceiling
